answer: A pre-written answer bank thus goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 62 aliases trips the duplicate check at the bridge gate. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a thread seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The mesa receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A 235 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
